Hi @gfelisberto, thank you for this issue.

A few basic questions first:
1. Does this happen regularly/every time, or do you see a pattern? Or maybe after a modem/router reboot?
2. Are you certain this happened since  2021.11?

There are routers which change ports (in your error `49154`) after a while or after a reboot. I think this happens in your case as well. To investigate this further, can you enable logging? You can do this by adding this to your `configuration.yaml` file:
```
logger:
  default: warning
  logs:
    async_upnp_client: debug
    async_upnp_client.traffic: warning
    homeassistant.components.upnp: debug
```

This will disable all other log-messages from home assistant itself as well as other components, so after you've got the upnp related logging it is probably wise to remove this again. Also, be ware that you're probably going to get lots of log messages. Feel free to filter those from other devices if you recognize those and redact any information you deem sensitive. You can also mail the logging to me directly, if you don't feel comfortable posting it here.

What we're looking for is the messages from your router, to see if it changes the port it listens on (scan for `location` in the logging.) If this doesn't change, perhaps the logging does give other clues on what is going on.

I turned on the logs. 
The last time I got the error was 3 days ago. The Router UI says that the Uptime is 16 days and the internet connection has been up for 4 days. So it does not seem related. Lets see if we get good logs when it happens again.

Managed to catch it. It seems your theory that something is causing the port to change is correct.
[logs.txt](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/7695440/logs.txt)
Great! Will take a look at it the coming week.
